recognize_zh: 電子顯微鏡下兩個相鄰的紅血球前驅細胞，核內高電子密度的異染色質聚集成粗大網狀帶並散佈許多圓形透亮小孔，呈「瑞士起司」樣外觀，是 CDA type I 的典型超微結構表現。
features: Two adjacent erythroid precursors on transmission electron microscopy
Heterochromatin condensed into thick, irregular, anastomosing electron-dense bands
Multiple round electron-lucent vacuoles within heterochromatin (Swiss cheese appearance)
Intervening pale euchromatin areas; nuclear membrane present
Moderately electron-dense cytoplasm with few organelles
describe_en: Transmission electron microscopy shows two erythroid precursors with abnormal nuclear ultrastructure. The heterochromatin is condensed into coarse, branching electron-dense bands containing numerous small electron-lucent vacuoles, imparting a spongy Swiss cheese appearance, separated by paler euchromatin. The cytoplasm is moderately electron dense with sparse organelles. Findings are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type I.

ddx.vs: CDA II shows double peripheral membranes from endoplasmic reticulum under the plasma membrane rather than spongy heterochromatin.
Megaloblastic erythroblasts have fine open chromatin with delayed nuclear maturation, not condensed heterochromatin with lucent vacuoles.
Normal erythroblasts show homogeneous peripheral heterochromatin clumps without internal vacuoles.
